description: R08 Host ScreenBuffer alternate resize checkpoint: safe Rust owns alternate viewport resize isolation and active-buffer screen-info projection while preserving the main viewport.

entries.notes: Safe Rust resizes the active alternate viewport without recursive main/alternate resizing, preserves the persistent main viewport and removes transient alternate state on return to main.
All Microsoft dx/dy combinations {-10,-1,1,10} resize only the alternate viewport; screen-buffer-info projection follows the active alternate while the main viewport remains unchanged.
